title: Dark lessons, portfolio and progress contain unreadable copy
reproduce: Choose Dark, or System with a dark device setting; open the Grade 8 first lesson, Portfolio and Progress.
observed: Body copy measured 1.73:1 on the dark reader; pale copy on white cards measured 1.11:1. Responsive vocabulary rows also retained white backgrounds.
expected: Curriculum, evidence and progress remain readable in each appearance.
fix: Shared paper/text tokens, explicit contrast pairs for badges and summaries, themed table rows and portfolio surfaces.
regression: dark/system keeps core reading, progress, portfolio and institutional demo accessible

title: Reading preferences do not affect the actual lesson
reproduce: At 1920px, measure a lesson paragraph; select Extra large text and Narrow width in Settings, then reopen the lesson.
observed: Saved preferences and document attributes changed, but paragraph text remained 16px. CSS targeted obsolete reader class names.
expected: Text and reading measure respond to the saved settings and survive navigation.
fix: Bind actual lesson document, response controls and workbook to the existing scale and width tokens.
regression: reading preferences change actual lesson text size and measure

title: Compact term map lacks keyboard modal behavior
reproduce: At 360px, open a lesson term map and press Escape or Tab.
observed: No dialog semantics or focus transfer; Escape leaves it open. Closed off-canvas links remain available. The global menu can cover term-map links.
expected: Focus enters and stays inside the map; Escape closes it and returns focus; background controls are unavailable.
fix: Responsive dialog semantics, shared focus trap, inert/aria-hidden background, scroll lock, focus restoration and hidden background menu trigger.
regression: compact term map traps focus, closes on Escape, and restores focus

title: Learner menu leaves background exposed to assistive technology
reproduce: Open the learner menu on Settings and inspect its background main content.
observed: The dialog claims modal behavior while background fields remain exposed.
expected: The active dialog is the only interactive/accessibility surface.
fix: Shared modal hook preserves and restores inert/aria-hidden attributes on background branches.
regression: learner menu makes the background inert while open

title: Nested main landmarks and no skip navigation
reproduce: Inspect Settings, Profile, Auth, Reset, Reader or staff gates; begin keyboard navigation.
observed: Two nested main landmarks on multiple routes; no skip link. A subsequent delayed-bundle regression reproduced a missing reader skip target during loading.
expected: One main landmark, with a first-Tab skip link; reader skip goes directly to learning content.
fix: Shell owns the main landmark; inner page wrappers use div; add focusable main/reader targets and skip link. Keep the keyed reader stage present through loading, error and loaded content so skip focus survives bundle completion.
regression: each workspace has one main landmark and a keyboard skip link; reader skip target keeps focus while its lesson bundle is loading

title: Default copy and System-light accents have insufficient contrast
reproduce: Open Home, grade map and reader with default settings; inspect response guidance and institutional buttons. Inspect System appearance on a light device.
observed: Response guidance measured 2.84:1; muted copy 4.43:1; copper labels 3.57:1. System-light incorrectly used pale dark-mode accent tokens.
expected: Normal text meets a 4.5:1 contrast ratio on its actual surface.
fix: Deepen base text tones; apply dark accent tokens only when System resolves to dark; use appropriate surface/text pairs.
regression: public learner, account and institution accessibility regressions; dark/system accessibility regressions

title: Lesson notes and term position lack names; brand label omits visible wording
reproduce: Inspect the reader note textarea, progressbar and brand link with accessible-name tooling.
observed: Notes and progressbar have no direct accessible name; custom brand label does not include all visible wording.
expected: Controls have meaningful names that match visible text where applicable.
fix: Name the note field and progressbar, add position value text, and use the brand link's visible text as its name.
regression: lesson notes and position indicator have accessible names and notes survive reload; public accessibility regressions

title: Reader print includes fixed navigation
reproduce: Print a lesson with a long response and a lesson note.
observed: Fixed reader/navigation controls appear in print; saved answers are represented only by editable form fields.
expected: Printed lesson includes the complete saved text and clear selections without application chrome.
fix: Print-only response text and notes, ink-on-paper colors, full-width document flow and hidden navigation/actions; mark selected controls.
regression: reader print preserves lesson copy and saved notes without fixed navigation

title: Reader load failure offers no retry in place
reproduce: Save an answer, inject a 503 for the Grade 8 bundle, then reload the reader.
observed: Failure has no alert/retry; return route can use a different active grade.
expected: Accessible failure with retry for this lesson and preserved work.
fix: Retry revision, alert/status feedback, saved-work reassurance and route grade for return navigation.
regression: lesson load failure offers retry in place without losing a saved answer

title: Institutional perspective tabs lack keyboard behavior
reproduce: Focus the Learner tab on the institutional demo and press ArrowRight, Home or End.
observed: Focus/selection do not follow tab keyboard conventions; panel is not associated with the selected tab.
expected: One tab stop, arrow/Home/End selection, and a labelled panel.
fix: Roving tab index, keyboard selection and tab/panel IDs and relationships.
regression: institution demo perspective tabs support arrows, Home and End

title: Demo learner call to action does nothing
reproduce: Click Continue learning in the public institutional demo.
observed: URL remains /institutions/demo; button has no handler or destination.
expected: A real destination with wording that reflects the illustrative demo.
fix: Open learner platform links to the curriculum library.
regression: institution demo learner action opens the curriculum

title: Header and account navigation have undersized touch targets
reproduce: Measure Staff sign in at 320px and inspect the account return link.
observed: Header link is 12px high; reset return link is 18px high. Original diagnostics record 78 small-target occurrences across the six viewports.
expected: Primary standalone navigation has a comfortable touch target.
fix: 44px minimum height on header navigation, account return and institutional back links.
regression: site icon resolves and header navigation offers a touch target

title: Discovery suite can pass loading shells and ignore browser errors
reproduce: Run original discovery and inspect grade-map screenshots and home console diagnostics.
observed: 84 checks pass while many map screenshots still show Opening Grade and six home captures contain a 404 console error.
expected: Successful captures show completed content, with errors recorded and enforced.
fix: Wait for route-specific readiness; assert landmarks, names, console/runtime/HTTP/real request failures; extend routes, themes, landscape and negative navigation. Retain narrowly identified speculative prefetch cancellations as diagnostics. Exclude generated Playwright evidence and scratch assets from ESLint so post-audit gates inspect source. Bound long-page screenshot collection at 30 seconds for the constrained audit executor.
regression: six-viewport surface and extended workflow suites; audit distinguishes cancelled speculative prefetches from failed navigation and data

title: Unbroken authored answer blanks overflow compact lists
reproduce: At 320px, open Grade 8 Lesson 72 and inspect document width and the list under the interview choices.
observed: The 320px document scrolls to 330px because 33-character underscore runs do not wrap within list items. The dedicated regression fails before correction.
expected: Authored text wraps inside the reader while source wording and saved choice identities remain intact.
fix: Allow long runs in reader paragraphs/list items to wrap; preserve source strings and controls.
regression: authored list blanks wrap at 320px and keep saved choices; complex-control discovery across six viewports
before: overflow-320-before.json; overflow-candidate.json; compact-before.json; final-audit-v2 failure trace

title: Authored list blanks bypass response controls and evidence capture
reproduce: In Grade 8 Lesson 72, try to answer the If yes, what surprised me most? list prompt.
observed: A plain list item renders underscores but has no input. The dedicated fill/persistence/portfolio regression fails before correction.
expected: The explicit authored blank is answerable under its existing stable block identity and included in its source-marked portfolio activity.
fix: Let list items containing explicit blanks reach the existing blank-field renderer instead of the plain-list early return. Keep ordinary lists unchanged; reuse blank-0 and existing persistence/evidence code.
regression: authored list response fields save under stable identities and reach portfolio
before: compact-fields-before.json; original list rendering and stable source block b60ef2e998c7dbfa1753a22f-1

title: Alternative activity disclosure has an 11px click target
reproduce: At 360px open the first Grade 8 lesson and measure the summary If the main task is not possible.
observed: The clickable summary is only 11px high; surrounding card padding does not toggle it. Dedicated regression fails at 11 < 44.
expected: A 44px target with pointer and keyboard activation and unchanged source content.
fix: Add minimum height and vertical padding to the native summary; retain its wording, marker and disclosure behavior.
regression: alternative activity disclosure has a usable touch target and preserves content; six-viewport target assertions

title: Account unavailable state has no h1 and lesson outline skips heading levels
reproduce: Open Auth in local mode and inspect the first lesson's heading outline.
observed: Account fallback has no h1; learning outcomes and stories begin at h3 below the lesson h1.
expected: One meaningful page title and coherent section levels without changing authored wording.
fix: Auth uses a full-page heading (compact panels keep h2); primary authored sections/notices/stories use h2 with the same visual styling.
regression: public accessibility regressions; six-viewport heading checks

title: Missing site icon generates a repeated 404
reproduce: Open Home in a fresh browser and request /favicon.ico.
observed: Icon endpoint returns 404 and first-page diagnostics capture a failed resource message.
fix: Provide an AC SVG application icon through Next metadata.
regression: site icon resolves and header navigation offers a touch target

title: Generic reader/account wrappers use unsupported accessible labels
reproduce: Inspect reader-progress and auth-entry with axe and accessibility-role tooling.
observed: Generic div labels produce aria-prohibited-attr incomplete findings; reader position has no named group role.
expected: A supported named role where useful; omit redundant generic labels.
fix: Make reader position a named group; remove account wrapper label while retaining its h1 and behavior.
regression: reader position and account wrappers use supported accessible names; four focused axe scans; full CI accessibility scenarios
